query: 网络安全风险治理 网络安全风险治理 网络安全风险治理 定性 衡量董事会与管理层对网络安全的治理、防护和响应能力。 2分 全面披露且治理闭环：同时满足以下三项：（1）董事会/专门委员会对网络安全承担监督职责；（2）制定网络安全制度并获外部认证（如ISO 27001、等保三级）；（3）披露安全事件应急响应机制及演练情况 企业管治报告/ESG报告中有明确描述，且三项均具备 1分 部分披露或制度不完整：满足上述2分标准中的任意1-2项，或在ESG报告中仅作原则性陈述（如仅声明“重视网络安全”但无具体制度名称、无董事会职责描述、无认证信息） 有相关披露但内容不完整，缺乏可验证的具体信息 0分 未披露或仅形式披露：ESG报告中未涉及网络安全治理内容，或仅以“本公司重视信息安全”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何实质性信息 无法从公开披露中获取有效信息 注意，本指标虽采用0-2分定性评分制，但为捕捉企业“报喜不报忧”的披露偏差，引入负面事件减分触发机制：若外部信息检索发现以下严重事件，评分结果在原有基础上降一级（2分→1分，1分→0分）： 事件类型 判定标准 信息来源 重大数据泄露事件 报告期内发生涉及用户/客户敏感信息的泄露事件，受影响记录超过10万条或遭监管处罚 隐私事务专员公署通报、媒体报导 监管处罚/整改令 因网络安全/数据保护违规收到监管机构行政处罚、公开谴责或整改令 证监会/联交所公告、工信部/网信办通报 重大勒索软件攻击 报告期内遭受勒索软件攻击导致核心业务中断超过24小时 公司公告、主流财经媒体报导 注：若企业已在ESG报告中主动披露上述事件，并详细说明整改措施与防范机制改进，可不触发降级（体现对主动披露的激励）。 网络安全治理 董事会网络安全监督 信息安全制度 等级保护 应急响应 灾备演练 网络风险管理委员会 数据泄露 敏感信息泄露 网络安全处罚 数据保护处罚 整改令 勒索软件 业务中断 主动披露 整改措施 防范机制改进 ISO 27001 等保三级 cybersecurity governance board oversight of cybersecurity information security policy ISO 27001 incident response disaster recovery drill data breach sensitive records cybersecurity penalty data protection enforcement remediation order ransomware business interruption proactive disclosure remediation measures preventive improvements 董事会或专门委员会是否承担网络安全监督？ 是否制定制度并取得ISO 27001、等保三级等认证？ 是否披露应急响应及演练？ 报告期内是否发生超过10万条敏感记录泄露、监管处罚/整改令或核心业务中断超过24小时的勒索攻击？ 事件来源、日期、记录数或中断时长是什么？ 企业是否主动披露并说明整改与防范改进？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '网络安全风险治理'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 董事会或专门委员会是否承担网络安全监督？ 是否制定制度并取得ISO 27001、等保三级等认证？ 是否披露应急响应及演练？ 报告期内是否发生超过10万条敏感记录泄露、监管处罚/整改令或核心业务中断超过24小时的勒索攻击？ 事件来源、日期、记录数或中断时长是什么？ 企业是否主动披露并说明整改与防范改进？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅称重视信息安全；仅有隐私政策；仅有防火墙等运营技术而无治理要素；未经可靠来源确认、非报告期或非集团事件。区分：本项初评治理监督并核验外部负面事件；第30项关注运营防护。外部事件只触发原口径降级，不替代治理初评。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Risk | Description | The Group's Follow-up Work Cyber and Data Security | Under the digital transformation, the real estate industry continues to deepen data management, and continuously improves and adopts advanced technologies and information systems to enhance operational efficiency. The daily operation of enterprises involves a large amount of confidential information, including property design, financial information, customer personal data, etc., increasing network and information risks, including information or system damage due to network incidents, corporate data or customer privacy data leakage, etc. | The Group works on both the management and technical levels to manage the risks. The Group has established a rigorous cyber and data security risk management and assessment system, as well as clearly defining the boundary for cyber network and data security, technical specification requirements, management procedures and corresponding emergency precautionary measures to enhance risk management capabilities. In addition, the Group adopts cyber security defence equipment such as network monitoring, hacker detection and vulnerability scanning systems to ensure network communication, data and personal data security etc. Fraud Risk | With the adjustment of macroeconomic policies and the slowdown in economic growth in recent years, the growth of the real estate industry has slowed down. The continuous pandemic has also caused the industry to face multiple internal and external pressures ranging from the market, capital, cost to supervision, thereby increasing the risks of fraud such as misappropriation of funds and improper procurement. The Group shall identify the relevant risks as early as possible, otherwise it may have a serious impact on its daily operations and the reputation, operations and finances of its stakeholders. | The Group has established policies such as the 'Intendance and Audit System', the 'Implementation Rules for Separation of Incompatible Positions' and the 'Tendering Management Methods' to ensure that employees are clear about the Group's position and requirements. At the same time, the Group also maintains close communication with its business partners to enhance the anti-corruption awareness of all parties, and opens up complaint channels to receive reports from all parties and handle them confidentially.

results.section: Material Issues / Excellent Services and Products
results.text: The Group makes all reasonable efforts to ensure all information for promotion or marketing comply with relevant government regulations and industry guidelines, and respects all property rights, including intellectual property rights. Employees are also required to abide by all relevant laws and regulations regarding the collection, possession, processing, disclosure, and use of personal data, while respecting the privacy of others and keeping the data obtained in the course of business confidentially. Employees from Hong Kong and Mainland China can refer to 'Employee Handbook' of the Hong Kong office and the 'Employee Relations management Methods' of the Mainland China offices respectively as all relevant requirements in different regions are listed in them. In addition, the Group has implemented firewalls, behavioural analysis tools, anti-virus software, and encrypted all files to enhance network security and protect customer data. The Group reviews its cybersecurity regularly and has formulated a contingency plan that sets out procedures and guidelines for responding to and handling cybersecurity incidents such as cyberattacks that may threaten its business.

[Section]
Material Issues / Excellent Services and Products

[Content]
The Group makes all reasonable efforts to ensure all information for promotion or marketing comply with relevant government regulations and industry guidelines, and respects all property rights, including intellectual property rights. Employees are also required to abide by all relevant laws and regulations regarding the collection, possession, processing, disclosure, and use of personal data, while respecting the privacy of others and keeping the data obtained in the course of business confidentially. Employees from Hong Kong and Mainland China can refer to 'Employee Handbook' of the Hong Kong office and the 'Employee Relations management Methods' of the Mainland China offices respectively as all relevant requirements in different regions are listed in them. In addition, the Group has implemented firewalls, behavioural analysis tools, anti-virus software, and encrypted all files to enhance network security and protect customer data. The Group reviews its cybersecurity regularly and has formulated a contingency plan that sets out procedures and guidelines for responding to and handling cybersecurity incidents such as cyberattacks that may threaten its business.

results.text: During the Reporting Year, the Group conducted a materiality review to understand the sustainability issues of concern to stakeholders. This not only helps the Group further understand its operation situation, but also guides the Group to formulate proactive and targeted implementation plans. The materiality review adopted a combination of qualitative and quantitative assessments to identify the latest issues related to sustainable development trends in addition to existing material issues. The Group identified and defined twenty-one sustainability issues and megatrends related to the real estate industry, covering environmental protection, employment and labour practices, operating practices, community and innovation. Stakeholders from different business sectors were invited to interviews to understand their views on issues and establish sustainability strategies. Besides, through questionnaire surveys, Board members and employees were invited to rank various issues according to their perceived importance to the business and stakeholders. Based on the opinions of different parties, the following seven important sustainable development issues of the Group were sorted out and approved by the Board and the Executive Committee.
